_readme: User-visible changes in the replacement app, newest first.

entries.summary: Restore SafariMS admin and Joshua/JP reviewer access after sign-in migration
detail: Bind admin and reviewer access to verified login identities in the app and server, including staging.
Quick reports capture the meaning and exact example currently displayed, with release/deck context.
Keep whole-card reporting available to JP; protect flags from cross-account overwrites.

entries.summary: Full-screen blurred backdrop overlay for Smart Skip word-filtering animation
detail: Added a fixed full-screen blurred backdrop overlay (backdrop-filter: blur(10px)) that activates when Smart Skip is pressed.
Centered the skipping animation card with frosted glass styling and smooth entrance/exit scaling in the viewport.
Fades the blur overlay and HUD out gracefully once word skipping completes, revealing the updated level stats.

entries.summary: Match Smart Skip size to Study button with glowing white indicator on active state
detail: Scaled the Smart Skip action button to 52px height, 22px padding, and 16px bold typography matching the exact footprint of Study and Practise.
Applied solid Study accent background fill with crisp white text and a bright glowing white LED indicator dot when toggled ON.
Preserved the clean neutral outline card state with hollow dot when OFF to maintain immediate clarity of the disabled state.

entries.summary: Refine Smart Skip into unified status-dot action pill and center Practice summary text
detail: Replaced the internal sliding switch with a sleek illuminated status dot indicator (○ Off / ● On) inside the unified Smart Skip action pill.
Tightened vertical spacing and removed dead-space padding around the Smart Skip footer so it sits cleanly and compactly beneath Study without large gaps.
Centered the Practice section summary text ('X waiting' / 'Nothing to practise yet') and chevron above the Practise button, matching the centered symmetry of Study.

entries.summary: Balance setup headers spacing and add sliding switch affordance to Smart Skip toggle
detail: Embedded a sliding iOS-style pill track and thumb inside the unified Smart Skip button with smooth CSS transforms and theme-adaptive coloring.
Trimmed excessive top padding above 'Choose your vocabulary' and 'Choose a level' so step content starts higher on screen.
Added healthy breathing margins and gaps directly below headers so title and content don't feel squashed together.

entries.summary: Style sense row part of speech as front-card pills and tighten rare uses icon badge placement
detail: Positioned the rare uses count badge snug in the top-left quadrant of the icon (top: 1px, left: 2px) close to the wifi signal bars, creating a tight square icon unit.
Replaced plain colored text for parts of speech in back-of-card sense sections with rounded pill styling (background tint, border-radius: 999px, white text) matching the front of the card.
Aligned sense section headers with align-items: center so the POS pill, lemma, gloss summary, and chevron stay vertically centered.

entries.summary: Omit zero counts from level picker progress legend and unify Smart Skip into action toggle button
detail: Updated the level picker progress stats line to render only categories with counts > 0, eliminating '0 Practice' and '0 Known' when empty.
Unified Smart Skip label and segmented switch into a single centered action button ('Smart Skip · On' / 'Smart Skip · Off').
Styled the unified Smart Skip button to match the visual language, radius, and weight of the Study and Practise buttons.
Maintained centered secondary summary ('Fewer cards, less repetition · Details ›') directly below the toggle button.

entries.summary: Eliminate runaway loading mark reflow loop and detach hidden loading screen to stop CPU overheating
detail: Enforced strict is-hidden checks in applyLoadingMarkImage and updateLoadingMark so background image rotation intervals never run when the loading screen is hidden.
Incremented loading mark generation on hideAppLoading so delayed async image manifest fetches immediately discard their results and never spawn background intervals.
Guarded synchronous offsetWidth layout reads and pop animations so hidden loading elements never trigger forced browser DOM reflows.
Added display: none !important and paused all child CSS keyframe animations on .app-loading-screen.is-hidden so the GPU and layout engine completely detach the overlay.

entries.summary: Integrate desktop song picker into Extra workspace and position Spotify banner below search bar
detail: Integrated the song picking section into the desktop Extra workspace with sidebar and background intact.
Transition seamlessly to full-screen lyrics translation once a song is selected or loaded via Spotify URL.
Reordered the search bar to sit above the Spotify paste link banner across both desktop Extra and modal views.
Added search filtering and language-aware catalogue browsing directly inside desktop Extra.

entries.summary: Clean up Extra workspace: full-screen lyrics translation and remove duplicate titles and navigation
detail: Open lyrics translation full-screen rather than embedding it inside a constrained workspace window.
Remove duplicate titles, eyebrow context pills, and redundant modal close buttons from Extra workspace.
Make lyrics translation card description generic ('lyrics of any song') rather than specific to the current artist.
Document UI guideline in CLAUDE.md to avoid duplicate titles and multi-spot navigation.

entries.summary: Fix card scrubber jumping on touchdown and skipping numbers abruptly
detail: Eliminated touchdown jump when grabbing the scrubber thumb by keeping card position stable on initial touch.
Implemented steady, tactile 18px per card stepping during drag so numbers advance sequentially without skipping.
Preserved direct track tapping so tapping anywhere along the rail continues to seek directly to the tapped position.

entries.summary: Fix card and level scrubbers getting stuck and jumping cards/levels
detail: Replaced artificial hold plateau and dead-zone calculation in card-position seek bar with direct, proportional rail positioning.
Set deck scrubber active state during card-position seek bar drag to prevent smooth-scroll fighting.
Prevented level ruler scrubber from executing premature level commits and programmatic centering while pointer drags are in progress.

entries.summary: Fix practice session loading and prevent multi-meaning cards from showing all senses greyed out
detail: Include related and knowledge-level review need in buildKnowledgeAwareCard so practice sessions retain due cards instead of dropping them and aborting.
Clear known sense flags when all senses on a card are learned and none are explicitly marked for practice, presenting the card whole rather than greying out every sense.
Add safeguards in updateCard and meaningTierClass to prevent fully learned cards from displaying as part-known cards.

entries.summary: Clearer Portuguese and Spanish function-word cards
detail: Centre pattern formulas, keep explanations left-aligned, and show contraction parts below the word without pills.
Place examples directly below patterns and match typed chunks to the app’s POS colours.
Simplify all 81 cards; use 71 traceable examples for the twelve reviewed pilot cards. Remaining source labels are explicitly unverified.

entries.summary: Align Tutorial, Walkthrough, About, and replica cards with current POS pills, ambient glow, and Smart Skip panel
detail: Set darkened POS pill colour (--front-pos-rgb), ambient card glow (--card-ambient-glow), and inflected 'from <lemma>' prefix on replica cards in Tutorial and Walkthrough.
Updated the Tutorial Smart Skip page and notes to match the two-line Off/On + 'Fewer cards, less repetition' + Details panel on the home screen.
Aligned About demo cards and footnote with the current single-POS back header, darkened front POS pill, and live Spotify playlist deck support.

entries.summary: Compact two-line Smart Skip panel on desktop and mobile
detail: Smart Skip and On/Off share the first row; “Fewer cards, less repetition” and Details share the second.
Removed the home-page information icon, example words and changing count to keep the panel compact.
Details opens the existing Smart Skip screen without changing the On/Off selection.

entries.summary: Lemma/POS pills lose their dark backing: each is its own colour, darkened, with white text; companion cue is small plain text
detail: Each companion card lists the lemma/POS pill(s) built from its own senses; the dimmed sibling pill is gone.
A single small "Card N of M" label sits on its own line under the pills and still opens the "why separate cards?" note.
Parts of speech of one lemma are one joined pill (hairline gap, only the outer ends rounded); full names, short names only when they do not fit.
No capsule behind any lemma/POS pill: the pill is a muted, darkened POS colour (mixed toward slate) with white text and no outline, straight on the card glow; a lemma is plain text beside it.

entries.summary: Fix language and mode state persistence bugs and enrich choice information across music and vocabulary
detail: Fixed critical bug where changing language or mode left activeArtist or window.activeArtist set, causing the sidebar and UI to still say Spanish when another language or mode was chosen.
Synced currentLearningMode() to accurately recognize music workspace without being masked by stale speech classes.
Enriched the Music choices screen with language-specific catalog counts, curated artist previews, and clear Spotify guidance.
Added informative album counts and vocabulary size metrics to catalog artist cards, plus clear descriptions in desktop trail dropdowns.

entries.summary: Guided on-page music mode selection and removal of redundant 'Back to vocabulary' button
detail: Landing on Music mode now visually guides the learner on the page with dedicated cards for Artists and Spotify playlists rather than jumping straight into artist browsing.
Removed the redundant '‹ Back to vocabulary' button since sidebar chips handle mode and language switching.
In sub-pages (Artists, Spotify playlists, Songs), the on-page '‹ Back' button returns to the previous guided step (e.g. from Artists back to music source choices).
Sidebar trail Level 2 reflects 'Choose…' until a source option is picked, keeping the sidebar and page in full alignment.

entries.summary: Desktop sidebar trail refined: 3-tier hierarchy with Vocabulary (Speech/Music) -> Music (Artists/Spotify) -> Source
detail: The primary Vocabulary chip now cleanly offers the Speech vs Music choice.
Underneath Vocabulary in Music mode, a dedicated subrow chip offers the music options (Artists vs Spotify playlists).
The source chip sits beneath the music options chip, displaying the selected artist or playlist name with quick switching.

entries.summary: Streamlined music navigation: eliminated nested sidebars, direct choosing set menu flow, and clear sidebar hierarchy
detail: Eliminated the nested secondary sidebar (Artists, Spotify playlists, Study setup) in the music complex; replaced with a clean horizontal source switcher.
Selecting an artist or Spotify playlist takes the learner directly through selection into the main choosing set menu without nested workspaces.
Desktop sidebar trail now reads clearly: Spanish -> Vocabulary: Artists / Spotify playlists -> Artist / Playlist name.

entries.summary: Streamlined 'Languages you know' modal with punchy Smart Skip copy and concrete bridge examples
detail: Replaced verbose modal instructions and 'coming soon' disclaimers with a punchy single sentence explaining the purpose of known languages for skipping familiar words.
Removed the redundant 'Manage all languages in Settings' button to declutter the modal.
Simplified the cross-language transfer explanation with clear, concrete examples (e.g., learn noche in Spanish → skip noite in Portuguese).

entries.summary: Mnemonic memory tips redesigned for intuitive cognitive clarity with hero morpheme flow & pattern twins
detail: Memory tips modal now leads immediately with the English anchor word ('Think of English: rapidly') rather than an edit script.
Replaced single-letter DNA alignment grid with visual morpheme chunking: emerald for shared roots and amber for shifting affixes (-mente → -ly, es- → s-).
Added pattern twins section showing how rules transfer across familiar words (e.g. totalmente → totally, perfectamente → perfectly).
Added Romance initial prefix rules (es- → s-), Italian language support, and amber lightbulb tile accent.

entries.summary: Modernized Portuguese function words with deterministic content cycling & ambient glow system
detail: Closed-class focus words (que, de, se, o, nos, naquele) now feature a deterministic grammatical layout on card backs with content-word variation pills (e.g. gostar, precisar, depender for de) and clean contraction breakdown formulas (em + aquele for naquele; contextual em + os for nos).

Function words receive a single, dedicated signature ambient glow: Periwinkle Moonstone Off-White (rgb(212, 218, 245)), giving structural grammar words elevated distinction without competing with the chromatic POS spectrum.
Non-function words receive ambient glow per Part of Speech: multi-corner radial lighting on unified cards with multiple parts of speech, and single-POS lighting on companion cards ('Card 1 of 2').

entries.summary: “Languages you know” moved into Settings → Study and shows flags instead of a sentence.
detail: Now sits under Show first on the Study tab (it was on the App tab).
The row shows one flag per language you know; hover a flag for its name. The explanatory line is now a tooltip.
Closing the editor returns you to the Study tab.

entries.summary: “Flag a meaning” is now “Revisit a meaning”, with a cards-and-arrow icon and a number.
detail: The card-back tile shows an arrow dropping onto a stack, meaning “back into the practice pile”; the number beside it is blank until you pick a meaning, then counts how many on this card.
The sheet title, tutorial step and demo card use the new name. What the button does is unchanged.

entries.summary: Portuguese (and other Wiktionary decks): meanings that all read the same, like fazer's five 'to make', now show what each one means
detail: fazer shows 'to do; to execute; to perform', 'to create; to produce' and 'to cause to' instead of three 'to make's; 'to make' moves to the note line.
Only when two or more meanings on a card share the same English, and only for short sub-glosses: explanations, topic labels (music, firearms) and long definitions stay as notes.
Portuguese: 159 distinct meanings change, e.g. seu 'his / her / their', bico 'beak', corte 'haircut', parada 'halt'. Spanish (SpanishDict) is untouched.
Display only: progress keys keep the original wording.

entries.summary: Desktop sidebar now shows your path as stacked chips (language, then Speech or Music, then artist) and each chip switches its own level.
detail: Under the language chip: a Vocabulary chip (Speech / Music) and, in Music, an Artist chip (artist, Mix artists, or a Spotify playlist). Click one to see its siblings and switch without going back to the start.
The language chip always names the language on desktop and opens the language picker; the artist moved to its own chip.
Learning settings (verbs, song translation) is now the Explore item in the sidebar.
Phone and narrow windows are unchanged.

entries.summary: Explain level goals and studying cards from first principles
detail: Level help explains what a level contains and the goal of learning its words, including the music-specific introduction.
Go describes studying unseen words, flipping a flashcard and marking whether you knew it.
The deck total starts on its own line after the introductory guidance.

entries.summary: Restore the overheating repair alongside the latest staging interface changes.
detail: A later staging deployment omitted the repair and restarted the recursive preload loop.
Combined the latest session help and colour legend with the cache repair, early worker update and missing-backend request fix.
Added a staging deployment check that prevents accidentally replacing the staged release with a branch missing its changes.
